name: Properties of triangles and quadrilaterals
definition: Named shapes carry guaranteed facts: a rhombus has four equal sides, a parallelogram has equal opposite angles, an isosceles triangle has two equal base angles. Recognising the name hands you the facts; assuming facts the name does not guarantee is the trap.
recognizeWhen: two sides of the triangle are equal
which of these is always true of a rectangle
the diagonals of the shape cross
misconceptions: I assumed a quadrilateral with equal sides had to have right angles.
I used the picture's proportions instead of the properties I was told.
I thought every rhombus was a square.
